bibl.title: Reimagining the Fall of Menander's Cnemon: Aelian's Rustic Epistle 15.
bibl.seg: Emilio Capettini, Reimagining the Fall of Menander's Cnemon: Aelian's Rustic Epistle 15.
bibl.note: Four letters in Aelian's collection (Rustic Epistles 13-16) reimagine part of Menander's play as an epistolary exchange between a grouchy old farmer named Cnemon, just like Menander's protagonist, and one of his neighbors, whose name, Callippides, matches that of the father of the young man who, in the play, falls in love with Cnemon’s daughter.
